title: How high technology is changing cargo crime
summary: Truckloads of turkey and bourbon are getting stolen in transit. Cargo theft of food and beverages are on the rise in part because the goods are hard to trace. We look at how high technology is changing cargo crime.

title: For workplace culture champions, Jensen Huang's return is 'unfathomable'
summary: Some who have worked to promote diversity and inclusion in Silicon Valley say Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia's CEO sends a message that all that matters is money.
